description: Find (overlapping) occurrences of an IUPAC motif on either strand, allowing mismatches.

limit.description: How many matches to return. `count` always reports every hit found and `truncated` says whether the list was cut.

motif.description: Query motif; IUPAC ambiguity codes (R Y S W K M B D H V N) allowed.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: motif_finder
title: Motif Finder
